services:
  opensearch-node1:
    deploy:
      restart_policy:
        condition: any
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.opensearch
      args:
        - SECURE_INTEGRATION=${SECURE_INTEGRATION:-true}
        - OPENSEARCH_VERSION=${OPENSEARCH_VERSION:-latest}
        - OPENSEARCH_INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD=[REDACTED]
    environment:
      - cluster.name=opensearch-cluster
      - node.name=opensearch-node1
      - node.roles=${OPENSEARCH_MANAGER_ROLE:-cluster_manager},data,ingest
      - discovery.seed_hosts=${OPENSEARCH_SEED_HOSTS:-opensearch-node1,opensearch-node2,opensearch-node3}
      - cluster.initial_${OPENSEARCH_MANAGER_SETTING:-cluster_manager}_nodes=${OPENSEARCH_INITIAL_MANAGER_NODES:-opensearch-node1,opensearch-node2,opensearch-node3}
      - bootstrap.memory_lock=false  # Disable memory locking for development
      - path.repo=/usr/share/opensearch/mnt
      - OPENSEARCH_INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD=[REDACTED]
      - plugins.index_state_management.job_interval=1
      # Network settings for proper node discovery
      - network.host=0.0.0.0
      - transport.host=0.0.0.0
      - http.host=0.0.0.0
      # Publish HTTP address for external clients only
      - http.publish_host=localhost
      - http.publish_port=9200
      # Memory settings
      - OPENSEARCH_JAVA_OPTS=-Xms${OPENSEARCH_HEAP_SIZE:-1g} -Xmx${OPENSEARCH_HEAP_SIZE:-1g} ${OPENSEARCH_JAVA_OPTS_EXTRA:-}
    ports:
      - "9200:9200"
      - "9300:9300"
    networks:
      - opensearch-net
    volumes:
      - opensearch-data1:/usr/share/opensearch/data
      - opensearch-snapshots:/usr/share/opensearch/mnt
    user: opensearch
    ulimits:
      memlock:
        soft: -1
        hard: -1
